description: P-O: hands the channels collected by the P-I module beside it out again, giving each output the number of channels its dial is set to; it goes to the right of P-I

params.text: Sets how many channels that output is given, 1 to 16; the channels are taken in order from the list the P-I module built

outputs.text: Carries the channels this output was given; where the list ran out, the remaining channels are 0V

notes: this module does nothing on its own: a P-I module must be placed directly to its left, and the lamp at the top turns green when they are joined
an output is given its channels whether or not a cable is patched into it, so an unused output consumes channels from the list all the same
the lamp beside an output is green when it got every channel it asked for, orange when it got some of them and red when the list had already run out
more P-O modules can be chained to the right to add further outputs, and they are filled from the joined pair outwards
